column1: # How to find each tensor of the Hugging Face layout (`facebook/sam3`, `detector_model.*`, `tracker_model.*`,
# `tracker_neck.*`) inside a checkpoint saved in Meta's original layout (`detector.*`, `tracker.*`; the file ComfyUI's
# SAM 3 nodes use). Both hold the same trained weights: 1,797 Hugging Face tensors are each reconstructed from the Meta
# One rule per line, tab separated: kind, Hugging Face pattern, Meta template, argument. The first matching rule wins.
#   pattern segments  `#` = one number (captured, numbered from 0), `*` = the rest of the name (last segment only)
#   template          `{0}` a captured number, `{0*3}` times 3, `{0*3+1}` times 3 plus 1, `{*}` the captured rest
#   kinds             direct     the Meta tensor as it is
#                     slice N    part N (0 q, 1 k, 2 v) of three equal parts along dim 0 (Meta fuses q, k and v)
#                     drop D,N   the Meta tensor without its first N entries along dim D (a class token)
#                     concat     the Meta tensors named in the template (comma separated), joined along dim 0
